## Activity

During March 2020, North City Eye Clinic recorded 318 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and the subsequent image-quality and grading outcomes. The capture total provides the overall volume processed by the clinic during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.9. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring problems affecting capture completion or review. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be followed up through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

A total of 53 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval between capture and grading remained limited during March 2020. The clinic should continue to review grading activity alongside image-quality results, particularly where ungradable images or equipment problems may affect the pathway from capture to final outcome. Any recurring camera issues should be recorded consistently to support review and remedial action.
